title: Life-of-Tread Cancellation Fee Schedule for Crestline Cardholders
content:
The cancellation fee withheld from the Life-of-Tread cancellation refund of a Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection certificate depends on the holder's Crestline Credit Card accounts.

**Life-of-Tread cancellation fee schedule.** A holder who has a Crestline Credit Card account in status active and no late fee posted on their Crestline card accounts in the last 12 whole calendar months pays no Life-of-Tread cancellation fee; a holder with an active Crestline card account and one or more such late fees pays 12.50 USD; any other holder pays the plan's administration fee, 25.00 USD on the Life-of-Tread plan.

| Active Crestline Credit Card account | Late fees posted on the holder's Crestline card accounts in the last 12 whole months | Life-of-Tread cancellation fee |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | 0.00 |
| yes | one or more | 12.50 |
| no | (not relevant) | 25.00 |

**Points of judgement.**
- The late fees counted are those on any of the holder's Crestline card accounts, not only the active one.
- A holder whose only Crestline card account is closed has no active account and pays 25.00.
- A late fee posted 13 months before the cancellation falls outside the 12-month look-back.
